summary: Completed Module 1 BUILD repository-understanding workflow using AI-assisted analysis plus manual trust auditing before accepting conclusions.
evidence: Produced architecture analysis artifact at `progress/architecture-summary.md` from AI-agent repository inspection only.
Produced manual trust-audit artifact at `progress/trust-audit.md` with explicit TRUST / VERIFY / SUSPICIOUS classification for architecture claims.
TRUST section captures directly verified claims with file references (entrypoint, routes, models, config validation).
VERIFY section captures reasonable inferences requiring runtime or deeper confirmation (worker queue behavior and design-level invitation integration assumptions).
SUSPICIOUS section captures unsupported assumptions (JWT secret presence implying auth and admin route protection without discovered guards).
Analysis phase did not modify application implementation files; outputs were saved to progress artifacts only (`progress/architecture-summary.md`, `progress/trust-audit.md`).
Workflow followed: ask AI to inspect repository, save analysis output, manually audit claims, and only then accept conclusions for future implementation planning.
